messages:
maria.k: Heads-up — planning reranker eval for the new 7B PTQ model. Thinking about holdout stratification + time-decay weighting because product queries have strong recency drift. Any strong opinions?

ben.t: +1 to time-aware splits. I'd stratify by (query_type, client_segment, month_bucket) so we get both traffic mix and recency coverage.

sara.i: FWIW we saw NDCG drop ~1.8 pts on the most recent month after PTQ in the last run. Possible data shift. Recommend plotting per-month NDCG & MRR and running bootstrap CIs.

ajay.r: Also watch out for leakage — session-level leakage killed one experiment for us. Group by session_id or user_id for the split. Don't sample queries independently.

ajay.r: Example sampling pseudo:```python
# group-aware holdout
servers = df.groupby('session_id').sample(frac=0.2, random_state=42)
train = df[~df['session_id'].isin(servers['session_id'])]
val = df[df['session_id'].isin(servers['session_id'])]
```

oliver.p: Another gotcha: tokenizer/normalization diffs between model prep pipelines. If you changed unicode normalization or lowercasing before PTQ, short queries (1-3 tokens) moved a lot and that hurt NDCG. Double-check preproc equality.

maria.k: For time-decay weighting, thoughts on exponential vs linear? I was thinking exponential to let recent months dominate but not erase older signals. What lambda range do people use?

sara.i: We use exponential decay w/ monthly half-life ~3 months for product queries (so weight = 0.5^(age_months/3)). For stable intents (docs search) we use no decay. Also compute effective sample size after weighting to ensure variance isn't exploding.

ben.t: I usually sweep half-life in [1,3,6] months. If results flip-flop across that range, flag the eval as "sensitive-to-recency" and surface that in the PR dashboard.

ajay.r: For statistical testing between FP32 baseline and PTQ model, paired bootstrap on queries is our go-to. Command we run:```bash
python eval.py --pairs-bootstrap --metric ndcg@10 --n-iter 5000 --group-by query_id 
``` Report median delta, 95% CI, and p-value.

oliver.p: On dataset hygiene: exclude bot/generated queries, filter low-signal automated retrials, and create a small stress set of tail/abridged queries (1-2 token queries, truncated docs). That stress set often surfaces regressions post-quant.

maria.k: Good set of actions. Plan: ajay, can you run grouped holdout (session_id), monthly buckets, and do half-life sweep [1,3,6]? Include per-month plots and paired bootstrap. Post results to this thread + attach dashboard screenshot. I'll block time to review. @oliver.p please verify preprocessing parity between pipelines.

ajay.r: On it — will run the sweep today and post results. ETA ~2pm PT.

eval-bot: Job queued: rerank-eval/1729876543 started (config: group_by=session_id, decay_sweep=[1,3,6], n_boot=5000).

maria.k: Awesome, thanks team :thumbsup:
